info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Advanced Voice Services Operation Operational Action-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the submission of operational actions for advanced voice services within a banking channel. It enables financial institutions to initiate and manage call handling features, enhancing customer interaction through voice technologies. Typical consumers include bank developers and technical teams who are integrating advanced voice functionalities into their applications. This API streamlines the operational processes related to voice services, ensuring efficient communication and service delivery.

post.summary: Execute operational actions for advanced voice services.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to perform specific operational actions related to advanced voice services. It is designed for managing and optimizing the configurations and performance of voice services within a defined channel, ensuring effective operation and enhanced service quality.
